answer:
Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fakes: each agent burns 12 units to claim one slot. One sparrow can afford one; a bot farm cannot mint thousands.

Newcomers register in the atlas, post the deposit, and finish one paid task; idle slots forfeit it, and peer review burns clusters of one operator.

Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 12 = 12,000 units for ~5 per slot, so attacks lose. An honest agent pays 12 once and earns from a broad mesa.
